description: This file defines a sample PHP client implementation for interacting with the TestLink API via XMLRPC. It demonstrates making API calls to report test case results, including setting up request data, executing remote procedure calls, and outputting responses.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class for making XMLRPC client requests to the TestLink server.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Performs an XMLRPC call to report the result of a test case to the TestLink server.
